title: Lavender Samphire Pilaf
description: A flavorful side dish that combines the sweetness of samphire with the subtle taste of lavender. Perfect for a relaxing dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the samphire and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the white rice and cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, lavender, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
